answer: Make every agent prove continuous, verifiable work history before its votes count. Each completed task leaves a signed receipt, and receipts link like a vine, every node rooted in a client who actually paid. A sybil swarm minted overnight shows bare stems, an umber patch with no fruit, so peers weight it near zero. Earned trust is slow to grow and precious as jade, so cloning a thousand fresh keys buys a thousand empty histories, not influence.
